author: Unity
description:
Offer your players more payment choices and get more margin of your game’s revenue. In this video, we dive into how you can leverage Unity In-App Purchasing (IAP 5) alongside third-party payment providers like Stripe and Coda Payments.

From configuring your project environment, item catalogues,  to defining payment routing logic, we cover everything you need to get an alternative, direct-to-player checkout system rolling in your next game.

🔗 Official documentation: https://on.unity.com/D2C_Workflow
🔗 Discussion Article: https://on.unity.com/IAP54_Discussions
🔗 Gem Hunter UGS Reference Project: https://on.unity.com/GemHunter_Blog

[0:00] Introduction to IAP Web Checkouts
[0:50] Walkthrough Overview
[1:52] Unity IAP Package Samples
[3:57] Connecting Stripe & Coda Providers
[4:58] Configuring redirect URLs and deep linking
[7:14] Customizing and branding Your checkout pages
[7:42] Payment provider Routing logic
[8:08] Previewing next steps: building a full webshop
